name: User interface
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize, then select Theme Settings and User interface.
Choose a design kit and button style, then set container widths, shared gaps, and section padding. Start with the defaults and change one scale at a time.
Top and bottom section padding combine with the neighboring section. Reduce one side when two large gaps meet; keep useful separation between distinct sections.
Set shared defaults here. A section with its own override may retain that override; select the section to adjust it.
Preview a home, product, collection, and cart page before saving shared changes.

settings.label: Default button variant
settings.info: Used by buttons set to inherit and the shared button class. Explicit section button styles take priority.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for default button variant. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.
